name: Far Lands
description: Replicates the 14 iconic Minecraft Far Lands biomes (Skygrid, NetherGrid, EndIsland, Stripe, Strip, Corner, Farther, 64-bit, Vertex, Comb, Pole, Edge Loop, Tunnel, Nothingness) as a worldgen ring around the map border. Coverage is configurable from 0% (disabled) to 100% (entire world) and scales with your world size. Pure worldgen, zero runtime cost outside the ring.

worldConfigAttributes.name: Far Lands coverage (%)
worldConfigAttributes.description: Percentage of map surface covered by Far Lands biomes. 0 disables the mod for this world; 100 makes every chunk Far Lands. Scales with the world size you picked. 30% is recommended for a balanced experience.
